main.description: A taco-counting leaderboard, created by its owner. There is no public directory of boards — the only way anyone finds one is via its shareable at://-derived link, which is what makes a board "private": unlisted, not access-controlled (the record itself is an ordinary public atproto record, like everything else in this repo). Written and read by tacocounter (https://tacocounter.bisks.net).

createdAt.description: When this board was created, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
